label: Shelter of the Faithful
description: Legacy 2014 background feature for Acolyte-style characters.
mechanics: You can perform religious ceremonies. Temples/shrines of your faith usually provide free healing/care for you and companions; you pay spell material costs. Co-religionists support you at a modest lifestyle. A connected temple may provide nonhazardous aid if you are in good standing.

label: Criminal Contact
description: Legacy 2014 background feature for criminals, spies, smugglers, and thieves.
mechanics: You have a reliable contact who acts as liaison to a criminal network. You know local messengers, corrupt caravan masters, or seedy sailors who can carry messages to and from that contact, even over distance.

label: Researcher
description: Legacy 2014 background feature for Sage-style lore characters.
mechanics: When you try to learn or recall lore, if you do not know it, you usually know where and from whom it can be obtained: library, archive, sage, institution, or knowledgeable creature, subject to the DM's ruling and possible cost or quest.
